research_question: Did RCEP entry change foreign-supplier link intensity differently from foreign-customer link intensity?

population.firm_universe: Valid listed tickers with at least one foreign customer or supplier relationship active at year-end 2017.
population.panel: Balanced firm by 21 Asian countries by relationship role by years 2018-2024.

roles.supplier: Foreign partner supplies the Chinese listed firm.
roles.customer: Foreign partner is a customer of the Chinese listed firm.

treatment.preferred: SupplierRole times country-specific RCEP timing; 2022 except Indonesia and the Philippines in 2023.
treatment.main_effect_note: Country-year fixed effects absorb the average country treatment.

outcomes.primary: asinh count of unique active foreign partner relationships in the firm-country-role-year cell.
secondary: Raw active-link count with fixed-effect Poisson
outcomes.interpretation: A positive coefficient means a more positive RCEP-period change for supplier than customer links. It is a formal asymmetry test, not mediation or certificate utilization.

estimating_equations.static: asinh(Links_fcrt) = alpha_fcr + lambda_ftr + mu_ct + beta(Supplier_r x Treated_ct) + error_fcrt
estimating_equations.dynamic: Supplier-role interactions with cohort-by-event indicators, event time -1 omitted, with the same three fixed-effect families.
estimating_equations.randomization_inference: Exact or 9,999 assignments preserving 14 RCEP and 7 control country labels.

identifying_assumption: Absent RCEP, supplier-versus-customer link differences within the same firm and country-year would not change differentially for RCEP countries after the three fixed-effect families are removed.

data_gate.link_support: At least 100 active links in every role by RCEP/control by pre/post cell.
data_gate.country_support: At least five countries in each role-group-period cell must have a positive link.
data_gate.firm_support: At least 50 firms must have positive supplier and customer links during the pre period and at least 50 during the post period.
data_gate.balanced_panel: Every firm-country-role cell must have seven annual rows.
data_gate.failure_rule: Failure of any requirement stops before coefficient estimation.

identification_gate.economic_threshold: Maximum absolute aggregated supplier-role lead <= 0.05 on the asinh count scale.
identification_gate.stop_rule: Failure stops before the static triple-difference, bootstrap, randomization, robustness, or mechanisms.

evidence_gate.positive_result: Static triple difference has randomization-inference p < 0.05, consistent sign under uniform timing and secondary outcomes, and no single-country dependence.
evidence_gate.inconclusive: Identification passes but the coefficient is ordinary under country-label assignments or too imprecise for a 0.05 effect.
evidence_gate.integrity: Supplier and customer results are reported together; no subgroup-star pattern is selected.

amendment_rule: Any change after freeze is appended to pap/amendments.md before execution.
